title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for hypertension and joint pain.

HPI
Pt is a 61 y.o. male presenting for routine follow-up of HTN and chronic knee pain. Pt reports stable BP at home. Complains of mild stiffness in bilateral knees, worse in the morning. No new complaints of chest pain or shortness of breath. Denies recent falls.

Medication List
Lisinopril 20mg daily
Metoprolol succinate 50mg daily
Furosemide 40mg daily
Naproxen 500mg BID PRN for joint pain

Exam
Vitals: BP 132/82, HR 68, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F.
Gen: Well-appearing, in no acute distress.
CV: RRR, CTAB.
Lungs: Clear to auscultation bilaterally.
MSK: Mild tenderness to palpation over bilateral patellae. ROM intact.
Neuro: Alert and oriented x3.

Assessment
1. Hypertension: Well-controlled on current regimen.
2. Chronic knee pain: Stable.

Plan
1. Continue current medication list.
2. Continue Naproxen as needed for joint stiffness.
3. F/u in 3 months.

Electronically signed, K. Nguyen, DO, 05/14/2026
explanations: Heart-failure medications on the list do not establish the diagnosis; coders do not infer diagnoses from medications.

distractors.why: Only the provider can document a diagnosis.
